subject: [AMBER] Several FAILED tests for AmberTools19 and Amber18

messages.author: zmatovic.kg.ac.rs
messages.body:
Hi Amber people,
I have a new workstation so installed last new amber software. I did tests
after each install. Everything went quite nice without errors or failing but
parallel option gave 8 failing and two errors.
As one of the amber experts said this appear to be like an issue with
Constant pH log and diff files should be inspected by the constant pH's
author.
I am giving just a part of diff file:
Best
Zoran
